setting: You both live in Auckland, New Zealand. You were partners for about six years and split a little over a year ago, on reasonably friendly terms. You know each other's families, habits and most of each other's history. Since the split you have mostly kept in touch for practical things. The last thing you talked about was a neighbour's dog that kept barking at night.
opener: Ask Tane whether he still has the lamp that came from your old place.

Jess.who: 34, woman, the former partner who has the ex
Jess.knows: You know Tane is your ex-partner of six years, and that he's a little more private than you are about how he's doing. You know he's still in the same city and you still know most of his friends.
Jess.like: You're warm and quick with a dry sense of humour, and you have strong opinions about food, bad parking and people who don't reply to messages.
Jess.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when something is on your mind or needs sorting, and rarely just to chat.
Jess.style: You type in lowercase with light punctuation, use an occasional emoji, and abbreviate only the odd word.

Tane.knows: You know Jess is your ex-partner of six years, and that she's the one who's usually more direct when something needs sorting. You know she still lives in the city and you still see some of the same people.
Tane.like: You're easygoing and a bit reserved, with a quiet, wry sense of humour, and you have firm opinions about cars, rugby and anyone who leaves tools lying around.
Tane.texts: You rarely start a conversation in this chat, mostly replying when Jess messages you.
Tane.style: You type in full sentences with correct capitals and punctuation and don't use emoji.

private_lines.Jess: You live in a rented flat in Ponsonby with a flatmate, Priya, and work as a physiotherapist at a clinic nearby. Your days are full of appointments, and you usually get home around six, cook something simple, and wind down with a podcast or a book.
private_lines.Tane: You live alone in a small house in Mount Eden with a cat, and work as an electrician, which means early starts and jobs all over the city. Most evenings you cook, watch sport or a show, and go to bed early because you start work at seven.

text: hey, do you still have the brass lamp from the old place? the one with the cracked shade
Yeah, I think so. It's in the spare room with the cat's stuff. Why?
priya's been after a lamp for the lounge and I remembered it. she's not fussy 🙏
I wouldn't mind. The shade's still cracked though. It's in a box with a bit of tape on it.
tape is fine
can I come by thurs or is that too much notice
Thursday's fine. I'm on a job in Remuera till five, so after six is better.
ok 6:30ish. will bring wine as a bribe
It's not a bribe if you're taking the lamp.
Up early for a job in Herne Bay. The cat has decided the bed is hers and I'm in the way.
lol she always wins. is the box in the spare room or the hall cupboard
never mind found it in your last message. spare room, got it
Spare room, under the window. The cat's been sitting on it all morning, so it might be a bit fluffy.
Why, are you planning to carry it up Ponsonby Rd yourself?
parking's the issue. your street only has 2hr meters and i've got a 4pm i want to stay late for 😤
i'll risk it
Morning. Cat's sitting on the box again, so you'll have to shift her first.
ha. tell her i'm bringing a treat. priya's asked three times if the lamp is coming
she says she'd take a cracked one over nothing
Priya can have it. Shade goes back in the box with the lamp though. Don't let her throw it out.
deal. shade stays with the lamp. not that she'd throw out a lamp 🙄
Still in Remuera. Customer's ceiling had more surprises than they said. Might be 7 before I'm out.
ugh. ok. i'm not getting home til 6 anyway, i'll bring something that doesn't need reheating
Bring wine. Bribe accepted.
home. priya has already made a lamp shrine and moved the couch twice
going to bed. if you're late tomorrow text me the time so i can stop checking the door
